storage.coverage: Paper checkpoints, research labels, model artifact, attribution, sampled decisions and EdgeLab learning (calibration, strategy record, wallet study); raw feed spool stays local.

H2.rule: buy the side Jev favours when |pJev - price| >= 5 points; ask + 1c stress; taker fee

S2.rule: 5m BTC/ETH: first print per round and token where p(spot model) - ask - fee >= 1c; buy at the ask; hold to settlement
S2.pass: >= 300 trades and mean return per $ with 0.5c latency stress - 1.645 SE > 0

E1.rule: at 3d before the scheduled end, buy the side priced 80-95c; history cost +2c, forward at the real ask +1c

kalshi.lastError: orderbook: RemoteProtocolError: Server disconnected without sending a response.

K1.rule: Polymarket ask + opposite Kalshi ask + both taker fees + 1c per leg < $1; first gap per round, up to 5 pairs
K1.pass: >= 100 rounds with a gap trade and mean P&L per pair - 1.645 SE > 0

K2.rule: as K1, but the first gap per round with net gap >= 4c after both fees and 1c per leg
K2.pass: >= 100 trades and mean P&L per pair - 1.645 SE > 0

rivals.notes: read-only study of public accounts; P&L excludes their volume-tier taker rebates (up to 44-50% of taker fees at $4M-$10M monthly weighted volume)

N1.rule: buy one YES of every outcome of a negRisk event when the basket costs < $1 after fees + 0.5c per leg; settle at resolution

S1.rule: buy the side priced 90-99.5c while a resolution proposal is live or after the scheduled end; settle at 1/0/0.5
S1.quarantineWhy: settled before 2026-10-30 by a lookup that did not check the returned market was the one traded; excluded

maker.why: slow maker on 5m/15m crypto: about -10c per $ (adverse selection), failed its test

fastmaker.why: fast maker: about -17c per $, failed its test

xmarket.why: Deribit options gap: about -33% per event, failed its test

pairacc.why: pair accumulator (GoodFallen replica) and its $200 wallet: about -25c per $; wallet stopped at its $120 floor

eventmaker.why: slow-market maker: failed its clean re-test (235 market-days, bad case -$0.13 per market-day)

jev.why: Jev LLM forecaster: about -32c per $, worse than the price; its OpenRouter credit is exhausted (402)

threshold.why: old fixed-threshold lane: lost money, superseded

lossbook.method: segments flagged only at 99% confidence and n >= 50; evidence for new experiments, never edits to a running rule

S2.unit: return per $ staked, 0.5c delay cost included

K1.unit: P&L per $1 pair (both fees and 1c per leg included)

backfill.mode: record-only: past rounds from Polymarket public data

skillVsLuck.method: one-sided t (normal tail) on last 60 rounds, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR, single-round concentration
